xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5275: Flywheel Needs-you: make the whole row clickable, not just the 12px icon

plan.title: Flywheel Needs-you: make the whole row clickable, not just the 12px icon
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: On the Flywheel page's Status tab, a Needs-you row's jump (open conv-flywheel at the message that first raised the item) is only reachable through a 12x12 px icon button. Clicking the row text does nothing and shows the default cursor, so the operator reports the items as not clickable (reproduced on build d0c9b93efe2, 11 rows).
narratives.Proposal: In src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/flywheel/FlywheelStatusPane.tsx, give each jumpable row (row.messageId set) a mouse onClick on the <li> that calls onNeedsYouClick(row.messageId), plus cursor-pointer, a hover:bg-warning/[0.14] background and group-hover brightening of the jump icon. The <li> gets no role, tabIndex or onKeyDown, so ACT 307n5z (PAN-5217) still holds; the native jump button remains the keyboard path and now stops propagation so one click is one call. Issue buttons, PR links and the item-target link stop propagation so they keep their own action. A click that ends a drag-selection inside the row does not jump. Rows without a first-raised id stay plain text. Docs in docs/FLYWHEEL.md and changelog.d/pan-5275.md; hover and jump screenshots in docs/screenshots/pan-5275/. Full detail: .pan/drafts/PAN-5275.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No role="button", role="link", tabIndex or onKeyDown on the Needs-you <li> (ACT 307n5z, PAN-5217).
- No change to the jump destination, FlywheelPage.handleNeedsYouClick, resolveNeedsYouAction() or the AskUserQuestion reopen behavior.
- No change to the in-flight table, the live agents list or NeedsYouIndicator.
- No change to which rows get a jump: rows without a first-raised id stay without one (PAN-5239 FR-7).
- No title tooltip on the row.
- No committed Playwright spec; browser verification is a one-off with committed screenshots.
- No contracts (@overdeck/contracts) or server change.

autoDecisions.summary: Make the <li> a mouse-clickable row (onClick only) instead of a row-level button or role="button".
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue allows either; a row-level button would contain the issue buttons and PR links, which breaks ACT 307n5z and reverts PAN-5217, whose test 'no button-role element contains another button or link' still guards it.

autoDecisions.summary: Keyboard support (Enter/Space, focus ring) is provided by the existing native jump button; the row gets no tab stop of its own.
autoDecisions.rationale: The jump button is a native <button> with a focus-visible ring, so Enter and Space already work; a second tab stop for the same action would need a role, which the ACT constraint forbids.

autoDecisions.summary: A click that ends a drag-selection of text inside the row does not jump.
autoDecisions.rationale: Without the guard, selecting an item's text to copy it would navigate away from the Flywheel page; plain clicks have a collapsed selection and still jump.

autoDecisions.summary: On a row with both an item target and a first-raised id, the link text opens the URL and the rest of the row jumps.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue requires inner links to keep their own action; the remaining row area is the jump target like any other jumpable row.

autoDecisions.summary: The hover screenshot the issue asks for is a one-off Playwright check in an isolated browser, committed under docs/screenshots/pan-5275/ and linked in the PR body.
autoDecisions.rationale: This follows the PAN-5239 precedent (D10, WI-10); no flywheel Needs-you Playwright spec exists to extend.

items.title: Make the whole jumpable Needs-you row a click target in FlywheelStatusPane

narrative.Action: Follow PRD WI-1 and decisions D1-D9 in .pan/drafts/PAN-5275.md. In FlywheelStatusPane.tsx: add the module-level endsSelectionWithin(row) helper (D6); for a row with row.messageId give the <li> className 'group -mx-1 flex cursor-pointer items-baseline gap-1.5 rounded-sm px-1 hover:bg-warning/[0.14]' and an onClick that returns early when endsSelectionWithin(e.currentTarget) and otherwise calls onNeedsYouClick?.(row.messageId); a row without messageId gets className '-mx-1 flex items-baseline gap-1.5 px-1' and no onClick. Do not add role, tabIndex, onKeyDown or title to the <li>. The jump button adds group-hover:text-foreground and its onClick becomes (e) => { e.stopPropagation(); onNeedsYouClick?.(row.messageId!); }. Issue buttons call e.stopPropagation() before onNavigateIssue; PR links and the item-target link get onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}. Type the event with import type { MouseEvent } from 'react'. Add the tests listed in PRD WI-1 to a describe('whole-row jump (PAN-5275)') block and add needsYouItems with firstRaisedMessageId to the fixture of the existing ACT 307n5z nesting test.
narrative.Tests: New tests in FlywheelStatusPane.test.tsx: 'clicking the row text jumps once (ac1)', 'clicking the jump button jumps exactly once (ac2)', 'an inner issue button navigates and does not jump (ac3)', 'inner PR and target links do not jump (ac3)', 'a jumpable row is pointer-styled but not a button (ac4)', 'a row without a first-raised id is plain text (ac5)', 'ending a text selection inside the row does not jump (ac6)'; extended: 'no button-role element contains another button or link (PAN-5217, ACT 307n5z)'.

items.title: Given a row whose item has firstRaisedMessageId 'm2', when the plain-text segment or the <li> itself is clicked, then onNeedsYouClick is called with 'm2' once per click; and when the jump button is clicked, onNeedsYouClick is called exactly once (toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)).

Given a jumpable row, when its flywheel-needs-you-issue button is clicked, then onNavigateIssue is called with 'PAN-5095' and onNeedsYouClick is not called; and when its flywheel-needs-you-pr or flywheel-needs-you-link anchor is clicked, onNeedsYouClick is not called.

A jumpable <li> renders the classes cursor-pointer and hover:bg-warning/[0.14] and has no role and no tabindex attribute; a row without firstRaisedMessageId renders no cursor-pointer class, no flywheel-needs-you-jump button, and a click on it calls nothing.

Given window.getSelection returns a non-collapsed selection anchored inside the row, when the row is clicked, then onNeedsYouClick is not called; after the spy is restored, the same click calls it once.
The ACT 307n5z test, with a fixture that now includes a jumpable row, passes: no element with the button role contains a button, a link or a [role=button]/[role=link] descendant.
Describe the clickable Needs-you row in docs/FLYWHEEL.md and add changelog.d/pan-5275.md
